jobs.label: 녹슨 갑옷병
jobs.prompt:
Create an eight-frame WALK sprite sheet for the Rusted Armor Soldier.
Image 1: exact appearance / palette / pixel-art identity reference.
Image 2: MANDATORY frame-by-frame leg pose guide, not an appearance reference. Its BLUE leg is the near, brighter armored leg; its PINK leg is the far, slightly darker leg. Copy the hip-knee-ankle geometry of each corresponding guide cell. In frames 5-6, the near leg must be LIFTED BEHIND toward LEFT exactly as BLUE is drawn; the far leg is forward and planted at RIGHT. Do not turn that into another near-leg-forward stride! Use the guide to make both legs alternate, not a repeated half-cycle. Recreate the entire guide's eight distinct leg poses with the SAME armor over those joints.
Layout: exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, chronological order matching the guide. Stationary torso and head center, same scale and foot-ground reference across frames. Soldier looks RIGHT in 3/4 view throughout. Match reference helmet, short sword, rusty charcoal armor, navy cloth and tiny red eyes; only pose changes. Opposite arm swings, sword lowered and firmly gripped. Near leg always drawn on top when legs overlap, far leg stays behind the near leg and darker.
Crisp coarse square pixel game art, no smooth painting, no thin high-resolution noise. Keep all eight complete figures and swords comfortably inside equal cells, with clear transparent space around each. Actual alpha-zero background. Do not output guide sticks, blue/pink colors, labels, white background, numbers, gridlines, auras or shadows.
jobs.repairPrompt:
Edit the supplied Rusted Armor Soldier 4-column by 2-row walk sprite sheet. Preserve its eight-cell grid, empty alpha background, exact same soldier identity and pixel-art shading, helmet, armor palette, sword and rightward 3/4 view. Repair its animation: the bottom row currently repeats the top row's near-leg forward stride. It MUST be the OTHER leg's half of the walk.
Keep top row frames 1-4 as the near/right leg stride.
REDRAW ALL FOUR BOTTOM ROW POSES with the FAR/LEFT LEG stepping forward, and NEAR/RIGHT LEG (the large bright knee plate under the visible sword hand) receding BACK toward screen LEFT. At frame 5 the broad bright near-leg kneecap and boot are on the LEFT behind the body and the slightly darker far-leg boot is on the RIGHT forward of the body. At frame 6 the far-leg boot is planted forward while the near boot lifts behind. At frame 7 the near leg swings underneath pelvis with naturally bent knee while far leg supports. At frame 8 near leg extends toward its next contact while far heel pushes off. Both leg identities must remain anatomically attached to their original hip and keep consistent light/dark shading. Do not horizontally mirror the whole sprite. Body and head ALWAYS face screen RIGHT.
Give both rows natural ankle roll and opposite arm swings; keep firm sword grip. All 8 poses distinct, not 4 poses copied twice. Fixed identical body size and centered pelvis in each cell. Same grounded foot baseline, small controlled vertical bob only. No outline halos, no painting blur, no lost hands or sideways knees. Exactly eight frames in 4 columns, 2 rows, single landscape PNG on actual transparency. No new images outside the grid.

jobs.label: 녹슨 갑옷병
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / sprite animation.
Input image 1 is the exact approved enemy idle appearance to animate. Preserve this one character's identity: same helmet shape, proportions, armor plates, hands, weapon, fabric length, eye pixels, and colors in EVERY frame. Do not invent new equipment or redesign any frame. The sprite is an anime-influenced coarse pixel-art belt-scroller game enemy viewed three-quarter toward screen RIGHT. Preserve the right-facing camera, dark narrow outlines, discrete block shading, clear square pixels; not smooth digital painting, no halos.
Deliverable: ONE transparent PNG sprite animation sheet. Exactly the requested number of temporal frames, in the specified equal-sized grid. These are successive poses of ONE character, not unrelated characters. Read left-to-right along top row, then left-to-right along bottom row. No labels, numbers, separator lines, text, grids drawn on the image, watermark, background scenery, checkerboard, ground shadows, fog, glow, detached effects or extra poses.
Layout constraints: the canvas is an atlas partitioned into equal cells, with zero external atlas margin. Each cell has generous INNER transparent margins. No character or weapon pixels cross a cell boundary. Keep the SAME character scale and logical square pixel size in every cell. Standing head-to-foot height is 68% of cell height, leaving room above for weapons and airborne poses. The pelvis projection is anchored at the horizontal CENTER (50% of cell width) of EVERY cell, never centered using the weapon's bounding box. Ground contact baseline is 88% down each cell; feet remain on that baseline in ground poses. No camera zoom, no global scale changes, no horizontal travel across the sheet. Animate joints and body weight instead. The body can bob only a couple logical pixels in walking, not drift randomly. Where a character falls, keep the fixed ground-contact reference and let the fall occupy inner horizontal margins.
Transparent cutout constraints: character pixels fully opaque, empty pixels outside silhouette genuinely alpha zero. Do not draw dark aura, floor, faint smears, semitransparent trails, or motion blur. Exactly two legs with coherent knee hinges, exactly two arms with clear hands and stable sword grip. Cloth reacts a little behind movement but does not occlude all leg joints.

Character: 녹슨 갑옷병 (rusted_armor_soldier).
Frame layout: EXACTLY 4 frames in 2 columns by 2 rows. Square canvas. Every cell contains a complete whole-body sprite. Reserve extra headroom for lifted swords. Do not crop any weapon.
MOTION: four-frame NORMAL GROUNDED HIT STAGGER; no launch and no death. 1 a small abrupt chest flinch with head recoiling and knees bracing; 2 deepest recoil leaning torso slightly BACK toward screen LEFT, arms flexed, sword kept in the hand; 3 knees absorb weight and body returns halfway upright; 4 almost recovered stable idle pose ready to return to source idle. Feet retain stable ground position, helmet direction remains RIGHT, no whole-character drift. Preserve exact armor and fabric palette. No red flashing, damage sparks, blood, duplicated hands or ghost arms.
